note: Include-only. build.py renders only these URLs, after a live check that each is MERGED and authored by the profile owner. New candidates go to data/review.json and are never rendered until a human adds them here.

items.issue: TensorListScatter computed its resize length as a signed highest_index + 1, so an index of INT32_MAX overflowed before the resize.
items.fix: Reject INT32_MAX with InvalidArgument and compute the length as size_t, matching the sibling IntoExistingList op.

items.issue: The GPU Dilation kernels counted elements in 32-bit signed ints, so tensors past INT32_MAX elements overflowed, tripped a CHECK, or launched too few threads.
items.fix: Promote counts and loop indices to int64 and launch through GetGpuLaunchConfig64, as gather_nd already does.

items.issue: An automated import in 2020 dropped the EuclideanNorm registration from tf2xla, so reduce_euclidean_norm failed to compile under jit_compile.
items.fix: Restore the PreprocessInput hook on XlaReductionOp and register EuclideanNorm as square, sum, sqrt.

items.issue: tf2xla registered BesselI0e and BesselI1e but not BesselI0 and BesselI1, so bessel_i0 and bessel_i1 aborted XLA compilation.
items.fix: Register both from existing primitives: I0(x) = I0e(x) * exp(|x|), and the same for I1.

items.issue: Grappler fused MatMul or Conv2D with a broadcast bias like [1, N], but the Eigen and GPU kernels demanded a 1-D bias, so the fused op failed inside tf.function.
items.fix: Accept any bias whose leading dimensions are all 1, matching the remapper and the MKL kernel.

items.issue: XLA RangeOp under jit_compile had no path for half, bfloat16, or integer dtypes, so those ranges failed at compile time.
items.fix: Wire the missing dtype handlers so Range works under XLA for those types.

items.issue: A convolution with an invalid rank aborted the Python process instead of returning an error.
items.fix: Raise ValueError so callers can catch the bad shape and keep the process alive.

items.issue: LookupTableExport skipped the dtype signature check its sibling ops run, so a key or value dtype mismatch hit a CHECK and killed the process.
items.fix: Call MatchSignature before exporting, so a mismatch returns InvalidArgumentError.

items.issue: Positional reads and writes on pseudo-terminals returned EINVAL in gVisor, where Linux returns ESPIPE.
items.fix: Set DenyPRead and DenyPWrite on both devpts file descriptions so pread and pwrite return ESPIPE.

items.issue: Value-mapping range inputs rejected minus signs, so you could not set a negative lower or upper bound.
items.fix: Accept signed numbers in the range fields so negative bounds type normally.

proof.anchor: should allow editing negative bounds on existing range mapping
proof.label: should allow editing negative bounds on existing range mapping

items.issue: delta_kt_prime halved the difference when only one neighbor was valid.
items.fix: Use the single valid neighbor difference as is.

items.issue: The CDP pipeline read its BigQuery schema from a relative path at import time, which failed on Dataflow workers.
items.fix: Load the schema through a runtime option and type the coupon join.

items.issue: Regex escape handling swallowed malformed input, and the error suite never ran because the files were named *Tests.java instead of *Test.java.
items.fix: Fail on bad escapes, and rename the suite so Surefire actually executes it.

items.issue: One unreadable remote file or failed local write aborted the whole pull batch.
items.fix: Handle failures per file, finish the remaining batches, and exit 1 on an incomplete pull.

proof.anchor: read and write failures do not stop the same or subsequent batches
proof.label: per-file failure tests

items.issue: Missing, nonpositive, or nonfinite pane sizes could reach PTY creation as invalid geometry.
items.fix: Route creation, resizing, and the attach plan through one helper that clamps to positive integers.

items.issue: Malformed input or a setup failure crashed exec.js before it emitted its JSON result.
items.fix: Validate inputs and route parse and config errors through the existing result emitter.

proof.anchor: invalid JSON and missing or invalid fields produce one JSON error
proof.label: JSON error tests

items.issue: Concurrent writes in one process shared a temp path, causing overwrites and rename failures.
items.fix: Give each write its own temp file and clean it up on failure.

proof.anchor: concurrent writes to one record all finish
proof.label: 100 concurrent writes test

items.issue: Under the daemon, inherited credentials skipped the resolver, so config changes needed a restart.
items.fix: Always run the resolver under the daemon.

proof.anchor: the daemon pre-flight demotes inherited env
proof.label: daemon pre-flight check

items.issue: Conv2DBackpropInput never checked that the filter had rank 4, so a scalar filter passed to conv2d_transpose aborted the process on a CHECK.
items.fix: Validate filter and out_backprop ranks up front and return InvalidArgumentError.

items.issue: The GPU RollKernel counted threads in int32, so tensors past INT32_MAX elements walked negative indices and faulted the GPU.
items.fix: Carry counts, dim sizes and strides as int64 and launch through GetGpuLaunchConfig64.

items.issue: LinSpace declared half and bfloat16 support, but only float and double kernels were registered, so those dtypes failed with OpKernel not found.
items.fix: Register half and bfloat16 kernels on CPU and default devices, with explicit casts in Compute.

items.issue: Under jit_compile, QuantizeAndDequantizeV3 accepted num_bits of 0 or below, while eager and graph mode rejected it.
items.fix: Apply the CPU kernel's num_bits range check when the input folds to a constant.

items.issue: A zero-window probe at RCV.NXT was ACKed before TS.Recent was updated, so the ACK echoed a stale timestamp, against RFC 7323.
items.fix: Update TS.Recent for a probe at RCV.NXT when timestamps are on, then send the ACK.

items.issue: One RTM_DELROUTE request removed every matching route, where Linux removes only the first.
items.fix: Stop matching after the first route, so a single request deletes a single route.

items.issue: Trace to logs ignored a configured V2 query when customQuery was omitted and fell back to the default tag query, dropping provisioned custom queries.
items.fix: Use the configured query when customQuery is true or unset.

items.issue: OSFLayer.merge() skipped check_adapters_to_merge(), so merging twice applied the OSF delta twice.
items.fix: Route merge() through check_adapters_to_merge() so an already merged adapter is skipped.

items.issue: For authoritative providers, cached model reads merged the bundled static catalog back in, so retired models came back after a warm cache write.
items.fix: Trust an authoritative provider cache as the full model set and keep static merging for models.dev overlays only.

items.issue: A failed catalog refresh re-saved the authoritative cache as non-authoritative, so the next launch merged retired bundled models back in.
items.fix: Decide cache retention from the cached payload's own authority instead of the effective authority after a failed refresh.

items.issue: The read result's Resolved path notice printed the raw absolute path, exposing the home directory, while every sibling render path shortened it.
items.fix: Render the notice through shortenPath(), matching the rest of the read renderer.

items.issue: Video reads with a frame or timestamp selector, such as clip.mp4:2s, failed for files outside the session cwd that suffix matching would have found.
items.fix: Keep a valid video selector split unless a literal file with the full name exists.

items.issue: The hermes in-band scanner started a tool call on a partial name when a chunk split inside it, so calls were reported under names like write_ that do not exist.
items.fix: Start a hermes tool call only after the name is complete, through one shared parser also used by qwen3.

items.issue: setrlimit(RLIMIT_MSGQUEUE) returned EPERM even when the new value equaled the current one, because the limit was missing from the settable set.
items.fix: Add RLIMIT_MSGQUEUE to the settable limits, so it is accepted and stored like Core, ProcessCount and RealTimePriority.

items.issue: renderGitLabMR concatenated an unawaited htmlToBasicMarkdown promise, so GitLab merge request reads showed [object Promise] instead of the description.
items.fix: Await the description conversion, as the issue renderer already did.

items.issue: A wide glyph in a column squeezed to one cell made the row one cell too wide, so the re-wrap pushed the trailing border onto its own line.
items.fix: Clamp each wrapped cell line to the column width before the row is joined between borders.

items.issue: The frontmatter repair path deleted every HTML comment in the document, including ones in the body.
items.fix: Strip only comments that lead the document right before the opening delimiter and keep the body byte for byte.

items.issue: Replay took the leaf from the last entry, so a late off-branch entry made the abandoned branch active and dropped the current branch from the resumed context.
items.fix: Off-branch entries record the leaf they interrupted and replay restores it.

items.issue: An oversized leading context line aborted a ranged read, so the requested lines were never returned.
items.fix: Retry from the requested start without leading context when the context alone hit the byte budget.

items.issue: The V2 dashboard save model kept a panel subtitle only on the snapshot path, so text moved there with Use as subtitle was gone after save and reload.
items.fix: Write the panel subtitle on the normal save path too; the snapshot path still interpolates it.

items.issue: The models.json to models.yml migration wrote the new file world-readable and non-atomically, exposing inline API keys to other local users and losing custom providers when a write was interrupted.
items.fix: Publish the migrated file through an atomic write that stages an owner-only temp file, fsyncs it and renames it into place.

items.issue: A credential resolver that threw, such as an unreachable auth broker or a failed OAuth refresh, was reported as a missing API key and never retried.
items.fix: Propagate the resolver failure as a configuration error that keeps the original cause; a resolver with no credential still reports a missing key.

items.issue: Clearing memory in one project deleted every project's rows from the shared memory database while only the current project's files were removed.
items.fix: Scope the database deletes to the current project's cwd, thread ids and consolidation job key, matching the filesystem cleanup.

items.issue: Markdown tables in the terminal padded every cell on the right, so right-aligned and centered GFM columns rendered flush left.
items.fix: Pad each cell by its column's alignment, including every wrapped line of the cell.
